sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in strong form with seven wins from their last five outings, and face an Alsager side languishing at the foot of the division with just four points from ten games. This should present a straightforward opportunity for the leaders to bounce back and extend their advantage.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to recover from their own recent loss and keep pace with Sandbach at the summit. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a mid-table clash between two sides in contrasting form—Bridgnorth have won two of their last three despite recent defeats, while Eccleshall show five wins in their last six. Wolverhampton Casuals (4th) travel to Wednesfield Community (9th), with the visitors on a three-game winning streak. Foley Meir host Bilston Town in a battle between sides in the lower-mid-table, with Bilston showing strong recent form. Market Drayton Town entertain New Mills; both clubs are struggling to find consistency, with Drayton winless in their last two and New Mills similarly patchy. Crewe (16th) host Allscott Heath (11th) in a fixture between struggling sides, while Shawbury United, on a catastrophic six-game losing run, host Barnton at home seeking to halt the slide. Brereton Social travel to Widnes Town in a bottom-half encounter, with Widnes having won just once all season. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in another basement battle. A midweek fixture on Wednesday 7 October sees Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community, offering both sides the chance to climb the table. The second half of the week also features Wolverhampton Casuals' earlier trip to Wednesfield, making for a repeat pairing in quick succession.
